This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 60 minutes when written.

3.1 · Annotation guidelines that work

definitions, examples, counterexamples, and an escalation rule.

3.2 · Agreement, corrected for chance

Cohen's kappa, Fleiss' kappa, Krippendorff's alpha, derived.

3.3 · When agreement is low

an ambiguous task, a bad guideline, or a genuinely subjective property.

3.4 · Adjudication and gold labels

majority, expert override, or keep the distribution.

3.5 · What labels cost

time per item, the budget, and where expert labels matter most.
